title: AI SEO Deck
text:
Demo for the Webflow Marketplace review
Recorded on the live app, 24 November 2026
AI SEO Deck shows whether AI assistants name your brand. Install URL: aiseodeck.silitlabs.com/auth
Webflow's authorization screen opens. Six scopes: authorized user read, sites read, pages read and write, CMS read and write.
First the denied path: Cancel is pressed on Webflow's screen.
The app says that it has no access and that nothing was stored.
The Install URL again, this time to approve.
One site is ticked, AI SEO Deck Demo, and Authorize App is pressed.
Setup opens. It asks for no website address: the address of the site is read from Webflow and shown read-only.
Brand name, other names, the country of the customers and the language of the keywords.
Rivals are entered by name only.
Suggest keywords from my site reads the home page through the Webflow API.
The ideas arrive with their monthly searches. Five are ticked.
Save and run the first check.
Each keyword is asked on six AI engines: ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini, Claude and Grok.
Each keyword is asked on six AI engines: ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini, Claude and Grok.
Each keyword is asked on six AI engines: ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini, Claude and Grok.
After about three minutes: which engines name the brand for each keyword, and how visible it is.
Overview: how many AI answers name the brand, what to fix first, which rivals are named instead and which sites AI reads.
A keyword, What AI said: the answer of each engine, the searches it ran and the sites it cited.
An answer opened. A rival is marked where it is named.
Site health reads the pages only when asked, and only through the Webflow Data API. Nothing is changed in Webflow.
14 pages read with GET /v2/sites/{site_id}/pages and GET /v2/pages/{page_id}/dom. The published site is not requested.
Each page gets a score and what to fix. /resources has no meta description.
Left: Now in Webflow, the title and description as Webflow has them at this moment. Right: the new values.
Write a suggestion with AI writes them from the text of the page. They are labelled as suggested and can be edited.
Apply to Webflow sends PUT /v2/pages/{page_id}. The change arrives unpublished, and Now in Webflow shows it.
The fix plan of a keyword names the best page for it, matched from the pages read through Webflow.
Write the fixes suggests a title and description, and answers to the questions people ask, next to Now in Webflow.
The answers can go to a CMS collection as draft items. The collection Posts is chosen.
Apply to Webflow: the title and description are saved unpublished and five items are created as drafts. Nothing is published.
The Designer Extension. In the Webflow Designer: Apps, AI SEO Deck, Launch App.
The panel shows the page that is open: its keywords, which engines name the brand, and what to fix.
Another page is opened in the Designer: Contact.
The panel follows the page. The title of Contact has 7 characters. Fix opens the editor.
The editor shows the values the page has now, read with the Designer API.
Write with AI suggests a title and description. Nothing changes until Apply is pressed.
Apply to this page sets the two values with page.setTitle and page.setDescription. Publishing stays with the user.
Apply to this page sets the two values with page.setTitle and page.setDescription. Publishing stays with the user.
The user publishes the site in Webflow.
The user publishes the site in Webflow.
Settings of the site. Disconnect this site says what is deleted and how to uninstall the app in Webflow.
The box is ticked and Disconnect site is pressed.
The data of the site is deleted from AI SEO Deck. Nothing changes in Webflow, and the site is still listed as authorized.
Connect is pressed.
Setup opens again and no Webflow screen appeared: disconnecting left the authorization alone.
The site is set up and checked again.
To end access, the user presses Uninstall App here in Webflow. AI SEO Deck then deletes the sites of that authorization and what it kept about them.
Prices in US dollars: Free USD 0, Solo USD 19, Studio USD 49, Agency USD 149 a month. Paid plans start with a 7-day free trial.
